name: Ablation-based learning IDE with integrated DOS environment

mentions.name: Ablation-based learning IDE with integrated DOS environment
mentions.description: This IDE includes an agentic plugin that removes (ablates) functions or code pieces for the user to complete, letting learners build toward a real program instead of doing leet-code exercises. It can guide users through bug fixes, and bundles a fully integrated DOS environment with a working debugger and asset editors. It also works on iPad.
mentions.problem: Leet-code style practice does not build toward real programs or lasting learning.
mentions.source_excerpt: An ide that has a full agentic plugin that allows ablating functions or pieces of code that one has to complete. So instead of leet code you can build towards a program and still learn something. It can also guide you with bug fixes and other stuff. And it also includes a fully integrated dos environment with a fully functioning debugger and asset editors. Also works on iPad.
